events.text_en: Two refiners of Thiên Bảo Trai's workshops cast a luan bell and carve jade pendants for their Dao-partner rite, and found Minh Loan Các on the coast to make ward bells for ships.
In the cold winter Minh Loan Các's great bell cracks as it cools in the pit and kills the founder Hoa Minh Hòa; the pavilion forbids casting in winter from that spring.
Minh Loan Các moves its casting floor up Tằng Loan Phong, where the Cloud Bridge bells rang true, and leaves its coast hall to the ships as the Bell Wharf.
